order: Close the probe/redraw cycle with a final ruling applied to the plan. Merge the two investigator classes into a single class — identical castings at every rung, a five-entry ledger, and the boundary treated as undecidable at intake — keeping the retired class name as an alias and nothing more; no other classes are merged, so the taxonomy holds at twenty-three classes exactly. Add a new decision procedure: seven fixed-order steps where the first match decides, and free entry into the later discriminator set can never reopen once closed. Amend three named discriminators and retire one, confining the change to those four; every other discriminator is untouched. Reframe classification as a routing hypothesis tied to risk tier plus author family; restate the downstream gate as misroute recovery and rewrite the next work order to validate through the router. Unblock the previously gated work order and close the outstanding pair ledger with dispositions recorded.
claims: The two investigator classes were merged into one, holding the taxonomy at exactly twenty-three classes with the retired name kept only as an alias; read-only-first ordering was internalized and the boundary treated as undecidable at intake. A new decision procedure of seven fixed-order steps was added, with exactly three discriminators amended and exactly one retired. Classification was reframed as a routing hypothesis tied to risk tier and author family, and the change stayed scoped to the plan documents it cites. The gated work order was unblocked, with the pair ledger closed and its dispositions recorded.
